simple.summary: כַּרְמִיל (karmîyl) means carmine , a deep red First listed occurrence: 2Chr 2 6.

definitions.full: H3758. karmil כַּרְמִיל noun [masculine] crimson, carmine , i.e. crimson stuff, cloth; late (probably Persian loan-word, and a derive. from Persian worm , see De ZDuth. Th. 1878, 593 ); — only 2Chr 2:6 ; 2:13 ; 3:14 (in all + תְּכֵלֶת (ו־ָןׅ אַרְגָּמָן 2:13 ; 3:14 + בּוּץ also ); read perhaps also for כַּדְמֶל Cant 7:6 (|| אַרְגָּוָן : so Gi, of hair formed spirally, like shell-fish; Gr, of glossy hair).
